architecture.fallback_changes: geographic extent; retain native pixel resolution
architecture.fine_query_shape: derived from actual geographic overlap; masked/padded shape buckets

training_proposal.accumulation_rule: normalize each objective by total valid weighted exposure across actual accumulation window
training_proposal.float16_fallback: requires gradient scaling and parity check
training_proposal.initial_loss: masked BCE with logits plus a clearly defined native auxiliary target
training_proposal.activation_checkpointing: profile before enabling; use non-reentrant implementation where supported
training_proposal.budget_is: planning headroom target, not a measured fit guarantee

scientific_prerequisites: real calibrated MODIS L1B and geolocation bundles
matched VIIRS mask/QA and trustworthy label coverage
one explicit target definition and units
event/region/time splits with context and temporal buffers
